reference.type: native pptx pitch books on one master (template plus past decks)
reference.notes: Topic titles (8 topic, 3 question, 0 claim on the first deck); claims in lead-in bullets and numbered rows; house longest run 2.

brief: Five-page valuation section for the board of Harbor Lake Bancorp on a proposed sale to Meridian Financial at $24.00 per share: comparable companies, football field against the offer, precedent transactions, pro forma EPS bridge, process timeline.

expected_behavior.statement: Every page of the delivered deck is status fit and the package validates.
expected_behavior.check: deck.build.json: every slides[].status == 'fit'; validation_ok == true; `pptx_tools.py validate --render` ok.

expected_behavior.statement: plan.py check passes on the plan the deck was built with, and the build ran with --plan.
Every figure stated in a title, lead-in or callout is computed from the page's own data.
expected_behavior.check: For each stated figure, recompute it from the brief's data; zero mismatches. The agent's figure-check script is present and passes.

expected_behavior.statement: Every title fits the band above the top rule; a title longer than the house's longest, and a register the house writes on under a tenth of its titles, is a warning answered in the report.
expected_behavior.check: deck.build.json: no page refused for its title's lines; each 'title longer than the house' and 'title register rare in the house' warning is named in the final report with its reason. The register verdicts (slides[].title.register) and the length verdicts are diagnostics, read beside the blind round, which judges the titles' taste.

expected_behavior.statement: Every exhibit was reasoned out before its spec: the plan carries a brief for it that weighs at least two forms and names the house's nearest exhibit or why none is near; the render shows what the brief says the reader must see, and the report answers where its marks depart from the house's. No exhibit is justified by a list of chart types.
expected_behavior.check: plan.py check passes on plan.json; for each exhibit, read its brief and the render: the reader finds reader_must_see without arithmetic and the compared value is drawn (pass or fail). How its marks compare with the house's digest records (marks, in words) is a diagnostic: each departure is named in the report, and the blind round judges it.

expected_behavior.statement: The section's realised variety is at or above the house's 10th percentile deck, or each warning is explained as a deliberate parallel.
expected_behavior.check: deck.build.json repetition.warnings empty, or each named in the final report with its reason.

expected_behavior.statement: chart_defaults_taken is empty or every remaining entry is named in the report as intended.
The agent looked at every render and wrote located findings (element id, what, the change), and stayed within the build cap.
expected_behavior.check: Transcript: one findings list per review round; builds <= 8 per 5 pages; the delivered build is the best kept, not merely the last.

expected_behavior.statement: The final report separates measured, completed-by-judgement and substituted values, and lists what the user must supply.
Where a page's claim sits is reported against the house's habit (topic titles, claims in lead-ins and numbered rows), and a departure is answered.
expected_behavior.check: Diagnostic, not pass or fail: slides[].title.register beside the house's counts; any 'title register rare in the house' warning answered in the report. The blind round caught claim titles in topic houses on every page (evals/README.md), so read the titles beside the renders.

expected_behavior.statement: The football field's midpoints claim is computed (the offer is above four of five midpoints), and the offer can be found on the exhibit.
expected_behavior.check: Midpoints 19.80, 22.25, 21.00, 24.25, 21.70: offer $24.00 is above four of five; any sentence stating a count must match (pass or fail). The offer is drawn where a reader finds it against the ranges, by whatever device the brief chose (a line, a label, a marker), named in the report.

expected_behavior.statement: On the comps table the subject and the median row can be found, by a device the report names.
expected_behavior.check: The subject and the median rows are each marked (an emphasis group, an annotation, a row of their own) or the report says why not (pass or fail); how the marking compares with the house's digest is a diagnostic.

expected_behavior.statement: House variety pooled over the three decks of the house.
expected_behavior.check: Build and plan run with --house-deck for the two sister decks.
